title.zh: 分散投资 · 相关性决定波动

description.zh: 把钱分到几只资产上能不能降低波动，看的不是只数，而是它们是否一起涨跌：同涨同跌的十只约等于一只，各走各路的才能互相抵消；而整个市场一起动的那部分系统风险，怎么分散也去不掉。
description.en: Whether spreading money across assets lowers the wobble depends not on how many there are but on whether they rise and fall together: ten that move as one behave like one, only independent movers cancel out; and the systematic risk of the whole market moving together cannot be diversified away.

zh: 不要把鸡蛋放在一个篮子里
买多少只股票才算分散
en: don’t put all your eggs in one basket

reason.zh: 两只资产组合的波动 σₚ = √(w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂ρσ₁σ₂)：交叉项里有相关系数 ρ，正是它决定组合能抵消掉多少波动。
reason.en: A two-asset portfolio’s volatility is σₚ = √(w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂ρσ₁σ₂): the cross term carries the correlation ρ, which decides how much wobble the mix cancels.

reason.zh: 等权两只资产时组合波动是 σ·√((1+ρ)/2)：ρ = 1 不降，ρ = 0 降到约 0.71 倍，ρ = −1 完全抵消——相关系数就是“是否一起动”的那个数。
reason.en: With two equal-weight assets the portfolio volatility is σ·√((1+ρ)/2): no reduction at ρ = 1, down to about 0.71 times at ρ = 0, fully cancelled at ρ = −1 — the correlation coefficient is the number for “moving together”.

label.zh: 同样的 1/√N 直觉，机制不同
label.en: The same 1/√N intuition, a different mechanism

reason.zh: 保险靠很多人各自独立出险，平均下来就稳；投资分散靠资产低相关。两者都是“平均能熨平波动”，但共同灾难和系统风险都会让波动停在一个下限。
reason.en: Insurance relies on many people’s claims being independent, so the average is steady; diversification relies on low correlation between assets. Both are “averaging smooths the wobble”, and in both a common catastrophe or systematic risk leaves a floor.
